platform.cpu: Octa-core, 1 × Cortex-X2@3.2 GHz + 3 × Cortex-A710@2.75 GHz + 4 × Cortex-A510@2.0 GHz

charging.claim: HUAWEI SuperCharge (Max 88 W); The phone supports 20V/4.4A (Max 88 W) super-fast charging and is compatible with 11V/6A or 10V/4A or 10V/2.25A or 4.5V/5A or 5V/4.5A super-fast char

rear_detail: 48 MP Ultra Lighting Camera (F1.4~F4.0 aperture, OIS)
48 MP Ultra Lighting Telephoto Camera (F2.1 aperture, OIS)
camera.features: 3.5x optical zoom (3.5x zoom is an approximate value, the lens focal lengths are 24.5 mm, 13 mm, 90 mm), and 100x digital zoom.

connectivity.wifi: 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz; 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax, 2 × 2 MIMO, HE160, 4096 QAM, 8 Spatial-stream Sounding MU-MIMO
connectivity.bluetooth: Bluetooth 5.2, Support BLE, SBC, AAC, LDAC and L2HC.
connectivity.positioning: GPS (L1 + L5 Dual band)/AGPS/GLONASS/BeiDou (B1I + B1C + B2a Tri-band)/GALILEO (E1 + E5a Dual band)/QZSS (L1 + L5 Dual band)/NavIC

specs.sensors: Gravity Sensor, Infrared Sensor, Fingerprint Sensor, Hall Sensor, Gyroscope, Compass, Ambient Light Sensor, Proximity Sensor, Laser Sensor, Colour Temperature Sensor
